detected_fault: Stuttering and lag while playing games
suggested_solution: Run a stress test (e.g., Prime95) to monitor CPU temperatures and identify potential thermal throttling issues.
Use HWiNFO or other monitoring tools to track GPU temperatures, voltages, and memory usage during gaming sessions.
Adjust power settings to prioritize performance over battery life.
Consider undervolting the GPU using Intel XTU or other software tools.
